# Multiagent orchestration

CRITICAL VISUAL RULE: communicate only through branch paths, checkpoints, spatial hierarchy, and restrained color. Keep every surface blank. Do not draw the GitHub logo, Mona, Octocat, Invertocat, the Copilot mascot, wordmarks, letters, numbers, code, charts, interface controls, badges, or labeled icons.

Create premium animated 16:9 GitHub key art, composed safely inside a 3:2 generation canvas. Render a bright editorial 2.5D scene on a white and warm off-white background with subtle contribution-grid texture, crisp Octicon-inspired geometry, soft neutral shadows, and generous negative space. Use approximately 80% white or off-white, 10% neutral gray, 5% GitHub green, and 5% Copilot purple.

Show four clearly independent specialist branch lanes for research, implementation, validation, and review. Route each lane through visible commit-like checkpoints and converge all four paths at one prominent human-controlled merge point. The visual metaphor must immediately communicate that parallel work succeeds because ownership and merge control stay centralized.

Keep the upper-left 42% calm for the exact native slide title. Leave a clean foreground position near the merge point where approved, unmodified mascot artwork can be layered later in Slidev. No people, mascots, logos, generic robots, words, letters, fake UI, screenshots, interface panels, dark panels, or watermarks.
